scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd apps/local-api build && bun run --cwd apps/codex-ai-bridge build && bun run --cwd apps/chrome-extension build && bun run --cwd apps/desktop build
scripts.test: bun test apps/chrome-extension/src apps/codex-ai-bridge/src apps/desktop/src apps/local-api/src packages/core/src
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/local-api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/codex-ai-bridge/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/chrome-extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit
